citations.assessment: Calls him Rav Acha bar Rav Ulla in the question about a plasterer’s shoe.
Acha bar Ulla sits before Rav Chisda and explains what was done to the ewe. The stray Abaye wording in Heilprin requires distinct treatment.

The matched unit is 5:3:7 in this edition. Rabbi Yonah gives his tithes to Acha on account of Torah study. The text contrasts reasons for the gift and should not be paraphrased as denying that Acha belonged to the priesthood.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

citations.assessment: This exact Pappa patronym transmits in Rav Acha bar Ulla’s name. It confirms the direction of transmission.
